relations.hypotheses: r=1 Wilson term, gamma5 hermitian with gamma5^2=1, gauge links unitary, standard hopping structure

relations.statement: det D_W = conj(det D_W), from det(gamma5 D gamma5)=det D and det(D^dagger)=conj(det D)

lemmas.statement: If gamma5 D gamma5 = D^dagger on a finite-dimensional space then det D is real.
lemmas.lean_skeleton: theorem det_real {n : Type} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (D G : Matrix n n ℂ) (hG : G * G = 1) (h : G * D * G = D.conjTranspose) : star D.det = D.det := by sorry
theorem two_flavor (x : ℝ) : 0 ≤ x^2 := by positivity

near_misses.claim: det D_W >= 0 for a single flavor
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: gamma5-hermiticity gives only reality of det; real negative eigenvalues can make the sign negative

near_misses.claim: All eigenvalues of D_W are real
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: D_W is not hermitian; only the spectrum is symmetric under conjugation
